$comment: Content batch 2026-11-14: designed content that is implemented but NOT live. Nothing here reaches the shipped game: sim/plannedContent.ts `withPreview` merges it into a copy of the data only in the testing sandbox (?sandbox&preview / ?debug&preview) and in `npm run balance:preview`. Names and descriptions come from progression.json buildingCatalog and roster.json heroes (already translated), so this file has no player-visible text. Numbers are PROVISIONAL, derived from a comparable live building or warrior: building level L takes the reference building's stats at the reference's max level at the first Keep where this building reaches L (one reference level further for each extra level in the same Keep, growing x1.16 power / x1.45 cost past the reference's last level), times hpMult / damageMult / costMult; hall limits are `count` copies at the catalog's max level for each Keep (`buildingMaxLevelAt`). Effects are the catalog's effect plus `effect` below. Heroes follow the Shadow Captain's rule: level L = the role's tier-3 warrior at its research cap at Keep unlockKeep + L - 1, per housing, HP x hpPerHousing and damage x damagePerHousing. To make one live: move its generated definition into buildings.json / battle.json heroes and hall.json, set live in the catalog, run npm run rules:snapshot BEFORE bumping SIM_RULES (combat data changes the fingerprint), then the balance suite.

whirling_blade_tower.$comment: Kunai Tower's HP; each spin deals half a Kunai shot to every ground warrior in reach every second (0.4x a Kunai Tower's single-target DPS per warrior, more than a Kunai Tower from the third warrior on).

rain_barrel_tower.$comment: Shuriken Tower's HP, half its damage (a support tower that also shoots); range 5.

listening_jars.$comment: Priced and built like the Paper Lantern Line (the live utility trap of the same Keep and level span).

living_bamboo_wall.$comment: Stone Wall HP at double the price (it regrows 3% a second); 25 segments.

straw_scarecrow.$comment: 1.5x a Kunai Tower's HP (lots of health), no damage, burns at double damage.

mirror_screen.$comment: 1.5x a Kunai Tower's HP, no shot of its own; every third warrior projectile flies back at full damage.

sand_bucket_post.$comment: Built and priced like the Bitter Smoke Brazier (the live support counter).

steam_vent.$comment: Kunai Tower's HP; half a Kunai shot each second to every ground warrior within 2 tiles, hidden ones too.

sleep_dart_tower.$comment: Shuriken Tower's HP; darts at 0.3x its damage every 1.5 s (they barely scratch).

rolling_log_chute.$comment: A Spike Pit's damage, along a 6-tile lane instead of a 1.6-tile circle.

lightning_rod_pagoda.$comment: Longbow Yagura's HP and price, no shot of its own; fires the absorbed lightning back once it holds half its HP.

hero_shrine.$comment: Hero Hall: built and priced like the Training Dojo. With heroChoice, the player picks one unlocked hero; the hero's level is capped by the Hall's.

iron_matriarch.$comment: Guardian tier 3 (Bell Warden) per housing, HP x10, damage x3. Bulwark: 60% less defense fire from a 90-degree forward cone (coneCos = cos 45 deg) on warriors within 4 tiles for 6 s.

sky_admiral.$comment: Sky tier 3 (Lantern Balloon) per housing, HP x10, damage x3. Squall: every flyer 2 tiles forward and 50% less damage from defenses for 5 s.

grand_sensei.$comment: Mystic tier 3 (Mist Weaver) per housing, HP x10, damage x3; fights (prefers any) so his first hit starts Inner Calm: 40% heal and one ward.
